add.name: Mary C
add.fullText: Our Austria trip was everything I’d hoped it would be. Before we even got on the plane, I told my husband, “If this works out, these worldschool tours may be how we travel for the foreseeable future.” The idea that I could go on a vacation that I didn’t plan myself, and actually enjoy each and every activity chosen for me, seemed too good to be true. But we love being outdoors, we love hiking, we love playing... so this trip seemed like a great fit. And we weren’t disappointed! Not only was the itinerary a blast, but this was the first trip in a long time that actually seemed like a vacation. This mama didn’t plan a single activity, cook a single meal, figure out any transportation... I was truly able to “vacate” and simply enjoy. The locations and hikes the Worldschooling Journeys Team chose were beautiful, the playgrounds and other kids’ entertainment kept my son occupied for days, and the spas were an awesome respite for my husband and me. We WILL be going back... and we WILL be booking future worldschooling adventures with Worldschooling Journeys!
add.shortVersion: This mama didn’t plan a single activity, cook a single meal, figure out any transportation... I was truly able to “vacate” and simply enjoy.

add.name: Lazka G
add.fullText: This was the BEST trip of our lives! This is a trip I wish every family had the opportunity to experience. Every day brought a new adventure: the views were incredible, the hikes were breathtaking and family-friendly, and there was always something to do. There was never a moment to be bored. The hotel was amazing, comfortable, and perfectly located, with everything you could possibly need within walking distance. The public transportation was unlike anything we have ever experienced: efficient, easy, and incredibly convenient. And the Worldschooling team is simply out of this world. We took a leap of faith after finding this group on Instagram and decided to experience a Worldschooling trip for ourselves... and it did not disappoint. You can truly feel the tremendous amount of hard work, dedication, and planning that went into making this experience possible. We are forever grateful for this opportunity, so much so that we are already coming back next year! THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!!!!! ❤️
add.shortVersion: This was the BEST trip of our lives! This is a trip I wish every family had the opportunity to experience... we are already coming back next year!

add.name: Stephanie S
add.fullText: It’s really hard to express what this trip meant to our family because I just don’t think words can properly express our feelings. Our Austria trip was such an incredible experience and I wish I could hit the rewind button and do it all over again tomorrow. The people, the adventures, the views, the food and again, the PEOPLE...! One of the best parts about a trip like this was that we didn’t have to do anything other than show up. Every day was planned to perfection, meals were always readily available, we didn’t have to worry about transportation or tickets or the timing of activities: we just had to show up on time in the morning and be prepared for a day that was, somehow, always better than the day before. Thank you for such a wonderful two weeks!!
add.shortVersion: I wish I could hit the rewind button and do it all over again tomorrow. The people, the adventures, the views, the food and again, the PEOPLE...!

add.name: Dante Paredes
add.fullText: Hi Worldschooling Journeys Team! We just wanted to thank you for such an amazing two weeks. This was our family’s first Worldschooling trip, and after this experience, it definitely will not be our last! From beginning to end, the trip was full of energy, adventure, learning, new experiences, and so many activities. There was always something interesting to do, but what made the experience especially memorable was the community you created around it. My wife, our kids, and I genuinely had a blast. We enjoyed exploring together, meeting the other families, watching the children connect and make new friends, and experiencing so many wonderful places and activities as a family in this amazing Austrian event! We also really appreciated all the effort, organization, enthusiasm, and personal attention that you put into the program. Organizing two full weeks for a group of families is no small task, and it was clear how much work and heart went into making everything happen. Thank you for welcoming our family and for giving us such a memorable first Worldschooling experience. We are leaving with wonderful memories, new friendships, and a strong desire to join another adventure in the future. Congratulations on everything you created, and thank you again from all of us! Dante, Hilda and the 3 kids!
add.shortVersion: From beginning to end, the trip was full of energy, adventure, learning, new experiences... but what made the experience especially memorable was the community you created around it.
